\section{\texttt{ToolRouter}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.tools.ToolRouter}\index{Classes!ToolRouter}

Deterministic keyword router that selects at most one tool per query.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
ToolRouter(self, registry: ToolRegistry) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{registry}] \texttt{ToolRegistry}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Explicit tool requests (\texttt{use the \textless{}name\textgreater{} tool}) are honoured when the tool exists and refused gracefully when it does not. Otherwise, the ordered \texttt{TOOL\_\allowbreak{}ROUTES} keyword rules decide; queries matching no rule fall through to the plain RAG flow.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}tools.\allowbreak{}py:511}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/249253f371fc682b42be23d75ec314d58837767d/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/tools.py#L511}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.tools}
